method: Directly viewed all8identified primary page images; compared the proposed selected verb surfaces and scoped rules. Full actual display coordinates are independently checked in the designer’s verbal-display crosscheck.

records.observed: Reduplicating verbs have a separate preterite formation; no ordinary class-I vowel series may be imposed on gehātan.
Hātan explicitly has hēt/hēton; selected prefixed promise verb retains this pattern, with present umlaut independently governed.
Dental þ disappears before -st; þ+þ becomes þ; analogical retained-dental forms are separately named. Supports the selected cȳst/cȳð and acknowledgement of alternatives.
Flēon is explicitly a class-II contract verb, distinct from class-I tēon and class-V sēon.

Contract-verb singular command retains h, long in classII. Drīfan gives ī/ā/i/i; rīsan, gewītan and wrītan are explicit members. Selected flēoh, ādrīf/rīs and short-i strong preterite second-singular follow the separate rules.
Distinct weak dental subclasses depend on vowel/consonant before d/t; gierwan may retain or omit w. Irregular wyrcean-type preterites/participles are separately specified.
Wyrcean→worhte/(ge)worht and bringan→brōhte/(ge)brōht explicitly listed; productive geworht must preserve the lexical prefix and earlier identity.

Willan has wolde in preterite indicative and optative, with negative nolde in both. A locally supplied negative first-singular report form can be supported without assigning the whole negative system.

limits: This records the listed primary observations. It is not a claim that each paradigm cell appears as a separate attested form in these pages.
